accessible_toilet.note: In both corridors and near the screens' rear entrances

sources.quote: There's step-free access to the wheelchair spaces and adjoining seats, and accessible toilets in both corridors, as well as near the rear entrances to the screens.

assistance_dogs.note: Vue: assistance dogs welcome in all venues

sources.quote: We welcome assistance dogs into all our venues.

hearing_assist_counters.note: Loops at all counters; a lowered counter

sources.quote: There are hearing loops at all of the counters, where food, drinks and tickets can be purchased, and pre-purchased tickets can be collected.

lift.note: From the shopping centre, to the rear wheelchair spaces, and to Screens 18 to 20

sources.quote: Vue Westfield is located on the third floor of Westfield London with lift and escalator access from inside the shopping centre.
If you've purchased a wheelchair space at the rear of a screen, you'll access your seat by lift.
Screens 18, 19 and 20 are all on level two, which has lift access.

notes: The page and the listings both name three screens "Scene 1" to "Scene 3". The page says every screen but 6 and 7 has infrared; the Scenes' hearing assist comes from their own lines.
